## Review checklist

- [ ] Scope and remaining limitations are documented.
- [ ] Validation results above reflect checks actually performed.
- [ ] No credentials, private prompts, or personal inventories are included.
- [ ] Changed documentation uses working links and agrees across English/Thai entry points, or translation gaps are noted.
- [ ] New data or assets have clear provenance and reuse rights, or none were added.
- [ ] Unrelated runtime behavior and host permissions remain unchanged, or changes are explained.
